0933d5925de61e1e6617ff8117aaa321.overview: A former Judo champion is given the chance to redeem himself after he befriends a competitor and an aspiring singer.
0933d5925de61e1e6617ff8117aaa321.tagline: In the world of Judo, failure is not an option.

0938ad53237846b247637db29a6cc66c.overview: Lin McAdam rides into town on the trail of Dutch Henry Brown, only to find himself in a shooting competition against him. McAdam wins the prize, a one-in-a-thousand Winchester rifle, but Dutch steals it and leaves town. McAdam follows, intent on settling his old quarrel, while the rifle keeps changing hands and touching a number of lives.
0938ad53237846b247637db29a6cc66c.tagline: The Gun That Won The West!

0939f5f0b4a24744078cd4e9b27e7d0c.overview: A year after Sheila is killed in a hit-and-run, her multimillionaire husband invites a group of friends to spend a week on his yacht playing a scavenger hunt-style mystery game—but the game turns out to be all too real and all too deadly.
0939f5f0b4a24744078cd4e9b27e7d0c.tagline: Any number can play. Any number can die.

0967536e7d24f5607b9d6bff1e8b8a82.overview: General Candy, who's overseeing an English squad in 1943, is a veteran leader who doesn't have the respect of the men he's training and is considered out-of-touch with what's needed to win the war. But it wasn't always this way. Flashing back to his early career in the Boer War and World War I, we see a dashing young officer whose life has been shaped by three different women, and by a lasting friendship with a German soldier.
0967536e7d24f5607b9d6bff1e8b8a82.tagline: An unforgettable story of forty gallant years.

09aaba330b1c8542ca7423887b46b829.overview: Lured by their dreams of fame and fortune, three ambitious young women enter the world of show business and discover how easy it is to sink into a celebrity nightmare of ego, alcohol and pills — the beloved "dolls."
09aaba330b1c8542ca7423887b46b829.tagline: In the Valley of the Dolls, it's instant turn-on… dolls to put you to sleep at night, kick you awake in the morning, make life seem great – instant love, instant excitement, ultimate hell!
